test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

HAZARDOUS
solution: The correct answer is '**risky**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Hazardous**' is '**risky**'. • **Hazardous**: dangerous. (ख़तरनाक, जोखिमभरा) • *Example: Surface water made driving conditions **hazardous**.* • **Risky**: involving the possibility of something bad happening; dangerous. (जोखिम की संभावना वाला, जोखिम भरा; ख़तरनाक) • *Example: It was far too **risky** for him to even attempt it.* **Correct Answer:__** *Risky.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Certain**: completely sure; without any doubts. (पूर्णतया आश्‍वस्‍त; संदेह से मुक्त, असंदिग्‍ध) • **Secure**: free from worry or doubt; confident. (संदेह या चिंता से मुक्त; आश्‍वस्‍त, सुरक्षित) • **Bulky**: large and heavy and therefore difficult to move or carry. (भारी-भरकम) 3f:Tbc4, The erroneous part is** 'did she'.**
